creation.configure: Dooro nooc daruur ah oo wata furaha API, ama habee matoorka deegaanka ee la doortay iyo faylalka loo baahan yahay ee goobaha Abuurida.
creation.localNote: Sawirada maxaliga ahi waxay adeegsadaan gal Diffusers oo dhamaystiran, qaybaha GGUF/Safetensors kala gooni ah oo leh stable-diffusion.cpp, ama NVFP4 CUDA miisaanyo la taageeray oo leh Python 3.15.1. Fiidiyowgu wuxuu adeegsadaa Diffusers. Xulashada CPU/GPU waxay u kala duwan yihiin cod-dhaliye iyo sawir-dhaliye ee matoorada ku salaysan qaybaha.
creation.autosave: Sawirro iyo fiidyowyo la dhammaystiray ayaa si toos ah loogu kaydiyaa faylalka Nova ee kala duwan ee ku dhex jira nidaamkaaga Sawirrada iyo Fiidyaha, oo leh habayntooda jiil.
creation.autoNote: Auto ayaa aqoonsan codsiyo muuqaal ama muuqaal cad oo Faransiis iyo Ingiriis ah. Had iyo jeer waxaad dooran kartaa qaabka wax soo saarka naftaada.
creation.source: Abuur hore ayaa loo isticmaali doonaa sidii sawirka wax gelinta
creation.variantPrompt: Abuur muuqaal cusub oo sawirkan ah, adigoo ilaalinaya mawduuciisa ugu muhiimsan.
creation.missing: Abuurkan waa la dhaqaajiyay ama hadda lagama heli karo kumbuyuutarkan.
creation.desktopOnly: Abuur muuqaal iyo muuqaal leh kayd toos ah ayaa laga heli karaa arjiga desktop-ka.
creation.inputUnsupported: Isticmaal hal sawir oo uu taageeray qaabka la doortay. Gelitaanka fiidyaha iyo sawirro badan oo wax gelin ah halkan lagama taageero.
creation.animatePrompt: Abuur sawirkan adigoo ilaalinaya mawduuciisa ugu muhiimsan.
creation.filterNote: Sawirka iyo Fiidiyowgu waxay shaandheeyaan wax soo saarka la sameeyay. Moodooyinka Multimodal-ka waxay fahmi karaan dhowr nooc oo wax gelinta; Tani mar walba macnaheedu maaha inay soo saari karaan sawirro ama muuqaal.
creation.inputRequired: Qaabkani waxa uu u baahan yahay sawir gelin
creation.generationOnly: Qaabkani waxa uu abuuraa warbaahin. Ka dooro qaybta Sawirka ama Muuqaalka.
creation.cloudNote: Jiilka daruuruhu wuxuu u soo diraa isla markiiba sawirkaaga iyo galinta bixiyaha la doortay waxaana laga yaabaa inuu ku soo oogo kharash. Joojinta gudaha ma baabi'in karto biilasha fog.
creation.cloudDefaults: Cloud waxay isticmaashaa bixiyaha-gaar ah presets. Halbeegyada maxalliga ah waxay khuseeyaan matoorka abuurka maxalliga ah ee la doortay.
creation.cloudTimeout: Shaqada daruurtu kuma dhammaanayn wakhtiga xaddidan. Ka hubi bixiyaha xaaladdiisa ka hor inta aanad bilaabin jiil kale oo mushahar leh.
creation.adobeCredentials: Adobe Firefly wuxuu u baahan yahay calaamad gelitaanka iyo aqoonsiga macmiilka x-api-key ee goobaha bixiyaha.
creation.catalogNote: Bixiyahaan waxa uu isticmaalaa liiska moodeelka la hayo. Dib u cusbooneysiintu ma xaqiijinayso furaha ama gelitaanka akoonkaaga. Jiil lacag bixin ah looma isticmaalo in lagu tijaabiyo aqoonsiga.
creation.ggufImageModel: Qaabka faafinta (GGUF ama Badbaadiyeyaasha ku habboon)
creation.ggufTextEncoder: Codka qoraalka (GGUF ama Badbaadiyeyaasha ku habboon)
creation.ggufNote: Dooro qaabka fidinta, codeer qoraalka iyo VAE si gooni ah. FLUX.2 Klein 4B, isticmaal cod-qaadaha Qwen3-4B ee ku habboon, oo ay ku jiraan kala duwanaanshaheeda GGUF. Faylasha NVFP4 ee la taageeray waxaa lagu diyaariyaa hal mar oo leh Python 3.15.1 iyo PyTorch oo la geliyaa kayd weyn oo ku habboon; asalka waxba iskama beddelaan. Tani waxay u baahan tahay meel disk ah oo dheeri ah iyo RAM. Ku hay sd-cli maktabadihiisa. Si otomaatig ah ayey u isticmaashaa qalabka la heli karo; CUDA waxay u baahan tahay dhismo CUDA ah. Distilled Klein wuxuu caadi ahaan isticmaalaa 4 tillaabo iyo CFG 1. Wax miisaan ah lama soo dejiyo.
creation.ggufWrongModel: GGUF kan waxa uu ka kooban yahay codeer qoraal ah. Ku dhex dooro goobta cod-bixiyaha oo dooro qaab fidineed oo gooni ah goobta sawirka.
creation.nativeNote: Dhaladka NVFP4 CUDA: FLUX.2 Klein 4B Miisaanka fudud, Qwen3-4B GGUF codeer iyo FLUX.2 Safetensors VAE. Waxay u baahan tahay Blackwell (Txanaha RTX 50 ama ku habboon), Python 3.15.1, CUDA PyTorch iyo ku tiirsanaanta NVFP4 ee ikhtiyaarka ah. Qoraal-u-sawir kaliya. Qalab aan la taageerin ayaa u fashilma si cad; dooro stable-diffusion.cpp si aad u waafaqid. Ma jiro kayd faafin BF16
creation.deviceNote: Qaybahani waxay leeyihiin doorashooyin qalabaysan oo madax banaan. Si otomaatig ah ayey u isticmaashaa qalabka la heli karo; NVFP4 dhalad ah had iyo jeer waxay u baahan tahay GPU ku habboon jiilka waxayna isticmaashaa qoraalka GPU-ga marka ay VRAM ku filan tahay bilaash. Qwen on CPU wuxuu badbaadin karaa VRAM laakiin codayn tartiib tartiib ah. Qwen on GPU wuxuu isticmaalaa lakabka ka saarida. In stable-diffusion.cpp, Auto raacay engine la doortay; ku qasbida CUDA waxay u baahantahay dhismo CUDA ah.
creation.totalTimeHint: Wadarta wakhtiga waxa ka mid ah rarista, codaynta qoraalka, jiilka, daruur kasta oo sugaysa, soo dejinta iyo kaydinta. Jiilka oo keliya ayaa si gaar ah loo muujiyaa marka matoorku soo sheego.
creation.recommendedSetupNote: Abuurid GPU, Qwen3-4B CPU, 4 tallaabo, CFG 1. Lagu tijaabiyey Windows/Vulkan; xawaare iyo iswaafajin waxay ku xiran yihiin qalabka.

creationInstall.confirm: Ku soo deji faylashan galkan? Ruqsadaha bixiyeyaasha ayaa khuseeya.
creationInstall.background: Waad sii sheekaysan kartaa oo abuuri kartaa sawirro ama muuqaallo inta la soo dejinayo. Horumarka kala soco astaanta barta weyn.
creationInstall.engine: Matoor ku dhex jira: CUDA / Vulkan / CPU si toos ah
creationInstall.note: Abuurid GPU, Qwen3-4B CPU, 4 tallaabo, CFG 1. Lagu tijaabiyey Windows/Vulkan; xawaare iyo iswaafajin waxay ku xiran yihiin qalabka.
creationInstall.error: Rakibiddu way fashilantay. Hubi shabakadda, booska bannaan, oggolaanshaha iyo ruqsadaha moodellada, dabadeed sii wad.

memory.title: Xusuusta moodellada gudaha
memory.autoNote: Waxay soo rartaa moodellada marka loo baahdo oo sii daysaa kuwa aan la adeegsan marka shaqada socotaa dhammaato.
memory.manualNote: Qoraal, sawir iyo muuqaal way wada shaqayn karaan wadahadallo kala duwan haddii RAM/VRAM ku filan yahay. Xusuustu way dhammaan kartaa.
memory.preserve: Faylasha iyo wadahadalladu way jiraan; moodelladu dib bay u rarmaan marka loo baahdo. Isbeddelladu waxay khuseeyaan codsiyada cusub.
memory.failed: Hagaajinta xusuustu way fashilantay. Isku day mar kale ama dooro Gacanta.
